Ghazi Mera Peer Shahid Baltistani Lyrics
Almaan Waliya, Shana Waliya.
Mera Lajpal Zahra Da Lal, Ghazi Mera Peer Sakhi Aye.
Tere Alam Te Deway Jalawan Ghazi Mera Peer Sakhi Aye.
Poriyaan Howan Kyun Na Duawaan Ghazi Mera Peer Sakhi Aye.
Pak Batool Di Pak Dua Ne Jis Da Noor Banaya.
Chaar Shaban Nu Oh Kabay Dey, Kabay De Wich Aaya.
Oh Hay Haider Da Parchawaan Ghazi Mera Peer Sakhi Aye.
Jannat Taun Nayi Aaya Kurta Zahra Aap Banaya.
Jis Da Jhola Khush Ho Ho Ke Hasan, Hussain Jholaya.
Chumiyan Zainab Ne Jis Diyaan Banwaan Ghazi Mera Peer Sakhi Aye.
Ultiya Jis Ne Maimana, Maisara Kitiyaan Dhair Tabaiyan.
Jis Diyaan Nazraan Aap Ali Ne Wich Siffeen Lahiyaan.
Mangday Shami Jis Taun Panahwan Ghazi Mera Peer Sakhi Aye.
Wekh Ke Jis De Chehray Nu Shabbir De Gham Muk Jawan.
Jay Aye Almaan Wala Rokay Do Aalam Ruk Jawan.
Kun Diyaan Malik Jis Diyaan Sanwaan Ghazi Mera Peer Sakhi Aye.
Ashiq Aye Shabbir Sakhi Da Umm Ul-Banin Da Chain Aye.
Chat Kabay Di Oss Da Mimber Te Unwan Hussain Aye.
Jis Te Aayataan Karan Nigahwaan Ghazi Mera Peer Sakhi Aye.
Bachra Mera Tere Akbar Da Sadqa Aye Maula.
Nazar Lagay Na Shala Ainu Matami Putar Aye Mera.
Kendiyaan Ro Ke Almaan Te Mawaan Ghazi Mera Peer Sakhi Aye.
Toon Aye Dua-e-Fatima Zahra, Maula Aye Teri Shan Aye.
Mawaan Bhaina Dhiyaan Di Tu Chadar Da Nigran Aye.
Teriyaan Chawaan Sab Diyaan Ridawaan Ghazi Mera Peer Sakhi Aye.
 Muhsin Ais Da Haider Wangoon Chehra Te Aawaz Aye.
Toor Ali Di Toor Aye Ais Di Waang Ali Andaz Aye.
Babay Waang Ne Kul Adawaan Ghazi Mera Peer Sakhi Aye.
